title: Return, v
logline: Friday. The first new Sunday, ruled. Wood at the Arches with the blue pencil. The tiers. He rules them and sits. The strip ends the week with the paper still blank, on purpose.

panels.composition: The garage. A sheet of Arches on the board. WOOD ruling tiers with a blue pencil. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, a man ruling horizontal tier lines on a sheet of watercolor paper with a blue pencil in a garage

panels.composition: Three tiers, ruled. Blank. The pencil set down.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, close-up of a blank sheet ruled into three horizontal tiers in blue pencil with the pencil laid beside it

panels.composition: Wood sitting back. Looking at the blank. The dog looking at the blank.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, a man and an old dog both looking at a blank ruled sheet, no words

panels.composition: The garage from the door. The board. The blank sheet, ruled. Sunday will be the first landscape in nine months. The strip stops before the first stroke.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, a garage studio from its doorway with a blank ruled sheet on a drawing board, a man seated before it and an old dog, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: The Sunday ruled and blank. The week ends before the first stroke.
